title: Soul Autofarm
features:
✅ MAIN TAB
🔹 Element Mastery Dropdown

Select and activate any element (Shadow Charge, Electral Chaos, etc.)

🔹 Teleport to Island

Instantly teleport to any unlocked island.

🔹 Unlock All Islands Button

Automatically visits each island sign to unlock all islands at once.

Returns player to original location.

Includes notifications.

🌱 FARMING TAB
⚔️ Auto Swing

Automatically swings katana to gain ninjitsu.

💰 Auto Sell

Auto-detects max ninjitsu and sells it by touching sell circle.

💠 Auto Chi

Teleports to Blue Chi Crates and collects them.

🛡 Auto Rank

Automatically buys all available ranks.

⚔️ Auto Purchase Swords

Buys all swords on the selected island.

🎒 Auto Purchase Belts

Buys all belts on the selected island.

🌀 Auto Upgrade Skills

Buys all skills on the selected island.

🥷 Auto Purchase Shurikens

Buys all shurikens on the selected island.

🏝 Purchase From Island (Dropdown)

Select which island store to use for auto-buy features.

🔄 Farm Hoops

Collects all hoops for coins.

Includes Hoop Delay slider to set time between each hoop.

🧬 Pet Dupe

Fires acceptTrade event repeatedly to dupe when hatching.

🥚 HATCHING TAB
🥚 Select Egg (Dropdown)

Choose which crystal to open.

🧨 Open Eggs

Automatically opens the selected egg.

💸 Auto Sell Pet Rarities:

Sell Basic

Sell Advanced

Sell Rare

Sell Epic

Sell Unique

Sell Omega

🔄 Auto Evolve

Automatically evolve pets.

🔥 Auto Eternalise

Converts to Eternal pets.

🌌 Auto Immortalize

Converts to Immortal pets.

⭐ Auto Legend

Converts to Legendary pets.
